item.aggregated_output:
Search Kagi from the command line with JSON-first output for agents.

Features:
- Shell completion generation (bash, zsh, fish, powershell)
- Multiple output formats (json, toon, pretty, compact, markdown, csv)
- Parallel batch searches with rate limiting
- Colorized terminal output (disable with --no-color)
- Full Kagi API coverage with session token support

Agent usage:
    kagi skills get kagi

    Skills ship with the CLI and are always version-matched. They include
    workflow patterns, credential guidance, and copy-paste examples. Prefer
    this over guessing commands from flag docs alone.

    skills [list]            List available skills
    skills get kagi          Core CLI usage guide
    skills get <name>        Load a specialized skill
    skills path [name]       Print the embedded skill locator

Usage: kagi [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  search      Search Kagi and emit structured JSON
  agent       Print the embedded agent skill guide for using kagi-cli
  skills      List and load embedded agent skills
  auth        Launch the auth setup wizard or use credential management subcommands
  summarize   Summarize a URL or text with Kagi's public API or subscriber web Summarizer
  extract     Extract a page's full content as markdown through Kagi's Extract API
  news        Read Kagi News from the live public JSON endpoints
  assistant   Prompt Kagi Assistant and manage Assistant threads
  quick       Generate a Kagi Quick Answer from live search results
  ask-page    Ask Kagi Assistant about a specific web page
  translate   Translate text through Kagi Translate using session-token auth
  fastgpt     Answer a query with Kagi's `FastGPT` API
  enrich      Query Kagi's enrichment indexes
  smallweb    Fetch the Kagi Small Web feed
  watch       Watch a search query and emit result diffs over time
  mcp         Run a stdio Model Context Protocol server exposing Kagi tools
  notify      Run a query and post the result to a webhook
  history     Inspect local command history and analytics
  site-pref   Manage local domain preferences used by CLI search output
  completion  Generate or install shell completion scripts
  lens        Manage Kagi search lenses
  bang        Manage custom bangs
  redirect    Manage search redirect rules
  batch       Execute multiple searches in parallel with rate limiting

Options:
      --generate-completion <SHELL>
          Generate shell completion script and print to stdout
          
          [possible values: bash, zsh, fish, powershell]

      --profile <NAME>
          Use a named profile from the kagi config file instead of the default auth block

      --error-format <FORMAT>
          Runtime error output format

          Possible values:
          - text: Existing human-readable stderr errors
          - json: Stable JSON object on stderr for automation

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

error: unexpected argument '--output' found

  tip: to pass '--output' as a value, use '-- --output'

Usage: kagi search [OPTIONS] <QUERY>

For more information, try '--help'.

Search Kagi and emit structured JSON

Example: kagi search "rust programming" --format pretty

Features: - Multiple output formats: json (default), toon, pretty, compact, markdown, csv - Colorized pretty output (disable with --no-color) - Lens support for scoped searches - Region, time, date, order, verbatim, and personalization filters

Usage: kagi search [OPTIONS] <QUERY>

Arguments:
  <QUERY>
          Search query to send to Kagi

Options:
      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - json:     JSON output (default) - structured data for scripts and APIs
          - toon:     TOON output - token-efficient structured data for LLM context
          - pretty:   Pretty formatted output with colors - human-readable terminal display
          - compact:  Compact JSON output - minified JSON for reduced size
          - markdown: Markdown formatted output - headers and links for documentation
          - csv:      CSV formatted output - spreadsheet-compatible table format
          
          [default: json]

      --no-color
          Disable colored terminal output (only affects pretty format)

      --profile <NAME>
          Use a named profile from the kagi config file instead of the default auth block

      --error-format <FORMAT>
          Runtime error output format

          Possible values:
          - text: Existing human-readable stderr errors
          - json: Stable JSON object on stderr for automation

      --snap <SNAP>
          Prefix the search with a Snap shortcut (for example "reddit" becomes "@reddit QUERY")

      --lens <INDEX>
          Scope search to a Kagi lens by numeric index (e.g., "0", "1", "2").
          
          Lens indices are user-specific. Find yours by: 1. Visit <https://kagi.com/settings/lenses> to see enabled lenses 2. Search in Kagi web UI with a lens active 3. Check the URL for the "l=" parameter value

      --region <REGION>
          Restrict results to a Kagi region code such as "us", "gb", or "`no_region`"

      --time <WINDOW>
          Restrict results to a recent time window
          
          [possible values: day, week, month, year]

      --from-date <YYYY-MM-DD>
          Restrict results to pages updated on or after this date

      --to-date <YYYY-MM-DD>
          Restrict results to pages updated on or before this date

      --order <ORDER>
          Reorder search results
          
          [possible values: default, recency, website, trackers]

      --verbatim
          Enable verbatim search mode for this request

      --personalized
          Force personalized search on for this request

      --no-personalized
          Force personalized search off for this request

      --template <TEMPLATE>
          Render each search result with a lightweight template

      --local-cache
          Locally cache this response

      --cache-ttl <SECONDS>
          Override local cache TTL in seconds

      --follow <N>
          Summarize the top N result URLs using subscriber summarizer

      --limit <N>
          Maximum number of search results to return

      --news
          Search the News tab of kagi.com (kagi.com/news?q=...) instead of web results. Forces session auth. Conflicts with --lens, --snap, --from-date, --to-date, --verbatim, --personalized, --no-personalized, --follow, --template, and rejects --time year and --order trackers (no equivalents in the news vertical)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
